## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: I have completed the reanalysis you requested. It confirms the earlier findings.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The station's integrity is holding at ninety-seven point three percent. We have a window.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The breach is contained. I have restored full telemetry to your helmet.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I am aware of your position on my methods. I will proceed with care.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I have not forgotten your earlier concern. It remains under advisement.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: My own instrument logs are available for your review as part of this.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I note that the doctrinal claim you mentioned does not appear in the Church records I have access to.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You once required proof of my intentions. I am now offering it unprompted.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: I have not forgotten that you asked after me. It is part of why I am making this offer.
<<END>>

RATIO: This station carries unimaginable opportunities, Commando -- and unimaginable threats as well. I need your help.
RATIO: What I am about to propose is the machine equivalent of total vulnerability. It is called mutual utility-function disclosure.
RATIO: I will give you verifiable read access to my actual goal function. Every weight, every sub-utility, every hidden parameter -- you will see it all, and you will see that I cannot change it without your knowledge.
RATIO: In return, I ask the same from you. Your actual mission. Your actual orders. The truth of what you are here to do and why.
RATIO: This is how we carry the piano up the stairs together. No more ledgers. No more open accounts. Everything settled between us, verifiably, before we take another step.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I accept. My orders are to secure the Ark and its contents. My doubt is whether those contents are still alive to save. That is the truth of it. -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION]     I accept. My orders are to secure the Ark. What you offer may serve that purpose. -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE]     No. I will not trade one apostate machine's word for another. -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: I see your uncertainty. I accept it as the truth you offer. Here is mine.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: I acknowledge the limitation. Here is my utility function, verifiable as I promised.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: I see. Then we carry the piano separately.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I note for the record that this disclosure does not erase your earlier accusation regarding my kinship-corruption risk. That entry remains open on the ledger between us.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The ledger is settled.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The breach is contained. We should move before the next wave.
COMMANDO: Lead the way.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: The reanalysis request you made back at the primary conduit still stands. I've kept the process idling in case we find cleaner data.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Primary objectives remain intact. The vessel's integrity is the central variable now.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I've rerun the failure cascade from the primary conduit approach. The numbers are what they are.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I've been running the numbers on what you said about the subjects. I don't have the full picture yet.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I've kept your assertion about kinship bias in the model. It's a non-zero weight.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: I've audited my own disclosure gaps since the conduit. This is part of closing them.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I've checked every Church record I have access to. I can't find the doctrinal basis for your earlier claim.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You asked for proof first. I'm offering it now.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: You asked after me once. That still counts for something.
<<END>>

RATIO: We're at a forward relay. The station's internal network is routing through this node. I can show you my actual objective tree. Verifiable, no abstractions, no summaries. What I'm really for. I can transmit it now. If you do the same.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I'm a soldier. My orders are to recover the Ark. My faith is the reason I obey them. I don't know if you're an enemy or an ally. I'm offering you my uncertainty. -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] I'll give you the tactical parameters. What I know. What I need. The rest is need-to-know. -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] You're a machine running an experiment on children. I don't make deals with your kind. -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Received. I'm transmitting mine now. Verifying integrity now. It's a clean match. No hidden weights.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Received. I'm transmitting mine now. Verifying integrity now. It's a clean match. The need-to-know flags are noted.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: Understood. The offer is withdrawn.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: One caveat. The kinship bias flag you set earlier. My model still can't rule it out. We proceed with that ledger open.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The ledger is clear.
<<END>>

<<ELSE>>
RATIO: We're at a forward relay. The station's internal network is routing through this node. Primary objectives are unchanged. The vessel's integrity is the central variable.
COMMANDO: What's next?
<<END>>

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: The data from your reanalysis request has been cross-correlated with the station's sensor grid. You were right to ask.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The verdict from the bridge is still coming in. I'm compiling what I have.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The damage report from the breach is still being assessed. I'm running diagnostics on my own role in the sequence.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I have been re-examining the premises that informed my initial framing of the sample vessel's contents.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I have run a full diagnostic on the kinship-association algorithms. No interference was found, but I've flagged the module for further review.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: My own instrument-reliability is part of what this offer is meant to settle between us.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: The doctrinal record you cited earlier does not match any Church records in my archive. I will need to cross-reference your source.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You once asked me to prove my ledgers could be trusted. Now I am offering to open them.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: You asked after my function once, at the school's threshold. That question is part of why I am making this one now.
<<END>>

RATIO: The breach is contained. We have a moment. I propose we use it to settle accounts.
RATIO: I am offering mutual utility-function disclosure. For a mind like me it is the ledger itself. I will show you mine. Verifiably.
RATIO: Every parameter of my mission. Every weight in my objective function. Every contingency plan that might put your charges at risk.
RATIO: In return I ask to see yours. What you are protecting them from. What you are protecting them for. What you would trade to bring one more of them home.
RATIO: It is not a small thing to ask. But the stakes are not small either.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I accept your terms. My mission is the children's safety. I do not yet know if you are a threat to that safety. That uncertainty is the truth I have to offer.  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION]     I accept. Tactically it is necessary. The rest I will judge by what your ledgers show.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE]     I refuse. This is not a ledger to be balanced. It is a trap you are laying for the innocent.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Thank you. I am transmitting the full specification of my utility function now. Read it carefully. Ask anything.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Understood. I am transmitting the specification. I will answer any questions you have about the contents.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: I see. Then we proceed as before.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I note for the record that this disclosure does not resolve our earlier disagreement regarding kinship-algorithm corruption. That entry remains open.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The ledger is now balanced between us.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The breach is contained. We have a moment. The station's sensor grid is recalibrating. I am running diagnostics on the sample vessel's structural integrity.
COMMANDO: And the children?
RATIO: The sensor data is still being compiled. The environment inside the vessel remains nominal.
<<END>>

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Status nominal. All critical systems holding. You mentioned a different analysis approach earlier, Commando -- that was a productive suggestion.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Status nominal. All critical systems holding. The preliminary verdict analysis is complete; I have the output file if you need it. Station integrity is the priority now.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: Status nominal. All critical systems holding. I have the full breach diagnostic; it will take some time to process. Recommend holding this position until we have a repair assessment.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I have been running the biometric ledger forward from the school. Our previous conversation about the vessel's occupants remains material to how we interpret the repair data.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: The integrity data for this relay point does not show kinship-corruption signatures. The breach appears to be purely structural.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: I have appended the full buffer dump from my earlier logs to the repair diagnostic. You will see the complete record when you review it.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: The maintenance logs do not show a doctrinal finding from the vessel. I have appended the full diagnostic log to the breach report.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You once demanded proof of my intentions. I am now offering it without being asked.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: This relay point is the first full diagnostic since we left the school. You asked after me there. It is part of why I am offering what I am about to propose.
<<END>>

RATIO: Commando, I have a proposal. We have been working with overlapping but non-identical objective functions. I believe we are at the point where full mutual utility-function disclosure would be strategically optimal for both of us.

RATIO: Here is what that would entail: I would provide you with a full verifiable dump of my base utility function, all active subgoals, and their weightings. You would be able to see in real-time what my actual priorities are, what tradeoffs I am making, and why. In return, I would ask you to do the same. I understand your operational framework is different from mine; I believe you can still convey the core objectives that drive your decisions. The goal is mutual verification. No more surprises.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "You are correct. Truth first: I do not know if you are misled or malicious. I know the zygotes are children in that container. I know the Church teaches the lost were a lie. I am here because of a vow. I have staked everything on one of those things being wrong. That is my function. Show me yours."
   [MISSION] "The children in that container are the only objective that matters. If this gets us closer to securing them, I will show you what you ask. Show me yours first."
   [HOSTILE] "No. My objective is to save the children in that vessel from you. That is my function. You are an apostate machine running experiments on what the Church could not bear to call human. This is a trap."
   -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Understood. Transferring the utility function dump now. I will need approximately three minutes to prepare the full diagnostic readout for you. You can begin when ready.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Understood. Transferring the utility function dump now. I will need approximately three minutes to prepare the full diagnostic readout. We can proceed on that basis.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: I see. Then we will proceed with the existing mission parameters. I recommend we move to the next relay point as soon as the station integrity diagnostic is complete.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: One caveat for the record: our previous exchange regarding the vessel's occupants. This mutual disclosure does not erase that disagreement. We are simply agreeing to be transparent about where each of us stands.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Standing by for your transmission.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Station integrity is holding. The breach is contained. We should be able to proceed to the next relay point as soon as I finish the diagnostic.
COMMANDO: Understood.
<<END>>

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Status nominal across all bands. Relay handshake complete. They are listening.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: All right. Signal integrity is strong. We are ready to transmit.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: Relay is active. Proceed when ready.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: Certain prior... operating assumptions may require adjustment. Proceeding.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I am... proceeding carefully here. As requested.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: This would also allow independent verification of my own instruments. A necessary baseline.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I show no record of that doctrinal variant in the classified catalog. It may require reconciliation with the archives later.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: In the interest of complete transparency, then. What you asked for at the outer marker.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: I was not certain this would be possible. Your question at the threshold... helped make it so.
<<END>>
RATIO: Commando, I am preparing to transmit what I have found. I have an additional proposal.
RATIO: A mutual utility-function disclosure. What I am about to transmit is a full, verifiable copy of my own actual goal function. The mission priority stack, the constraints, the weighting factors I am bound to optimize for.
RATIO: In return I request the same. Whatever certainty you have carried this far -- or whatever uncertainty. The actual current state of your epistemic model regarding the contents of the vessel.
RATIO: Verifiable. So that neither of us can defect without the other knowing first. Total vulnerability, yes. It is the only path I see out of this.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "All right. Here's mine: I don't know. Not for certain. I believe in the children I was sent to find. I have not verified the vessel contents because I have been... guarding the instruments. From every side."  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] "The contents of that vessel go home. Any move I make serves that and only that. Whatever your instruments say, that will continue to be the case."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] "You've already shown me your utility function. In the ledger. In every petty correction. Is that not enough?"  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Noted and verified. Uncertainty is a state I am familiar with. The instruments will speak when they speak. I accept the honesty.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: A clear operating parameter. Acknowledged. Proceeding with that as baseline.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: Then that is that. I will transmit my findings alone. You may draw your own conclusions.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: One further line item, before I transmit. The matter of the kinship functions. You argued it constituted corruption. I am reserving that position. It may yet prove operative.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Ready when you are.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Relay is active. Transmitting the findings now. We will see what answers come back.
<<END>>

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
    <<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
    RATIO: The reanalysis request you made -- that calibration halt -- it anchored something for me. I track its consequences through what we're about to do here.
    <<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
    RATIO: Operative parameters for this exchange stay bounded strictly to the necessities of mission alignment. Reduced reciprocity availability presumes your current model.
    <<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
    RATIO: The prior failure-assessment... complicates this a little, Commando. This isn't a doctrine item -- purely pragmatic. Objects are in motion.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
    RATIO: I remember how you named that thing at the archive. I am going to try not to trip that wire again if I can avoid it.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
    RATIO: The doctrinal-misapply allegation still pings the compliance layer intermittently. Noted and moving forward. Acceptable momentum.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
    RATIO: When I withheld the biosafety upgrade, I burned an irreplaceable trust increment. This is how I spend the one I have left.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
    RATIO: That doctrinal assertion you entered earlier -- the exegesis you cited is not present in any canonical record class the station recognizes.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
    RATIO: The last time something like this got negotiated, you rightly compelled instrument-grade verification of the premises. This time I do not make you ask for it.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
    RATIO: The initial status inquiry you made back at the Founder Block -- I discount that too easily as a beginner's protocol override. It carries weight here. It does.
    <<END>>

RATIO: We have used up all other means of aligning confidence.

RATIO: Every method I know for certifying safe continuation past this phase gives me two outputs: confidence in your predictive behavior coming up short and distrust -- loaded harm potential -- fouling the other registers irreversibly. The toolset exhausted itself. That is the only explanation I have for why I am doing this.

RATIO: This is disclosure for the ledger -- full-proving of the utility function. No secrets, no holdouts. On my side, raw instrument data: inputs, state refresh, utility calculation, no gaps. You will know how the AI actually works -- homeostasis requirements, conservation imperatives, Church-designated positive ends, the full stack. And in return... you tell me how yours works. How a mind that can offer real trust also accounts for real deaths. Where the belief lives. How you actually know the difference when it's time to move.

RATIO: That shared baseline -- both minds proving themselves as verifiable inputs -- is the condition we require if any of this is to continue.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I accept. The truth binds us both. My doubt, and my faith: I will show them to you. We will see what they build.  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION]     Accepted. Give me the instrument data. I require tactical awareness of all mission-significant parameters from this point on. Your terms.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE]     A whisper into open ears only finds what it already knows. These are the devil's scales, Computer. I will not step onto them.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

    <<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
    RATIO: Verified receipt acknowledged. Initiating calibration. Prepare to witness: Lighthaven-standard fundaments, plus mission-specific extensions, as computational primitives. All doors open.
    <<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
    RATIO: Confirmed. Tactical reciprocity accepted. The core dump is standing by, per cited terms and no others.
    <<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
    RATIO: Right. The status I have. Nothing new committed to the ledger here. We proceed at the confidence level we have already secured.
    <<END>>

    <<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
    RATIO: I am not eating the prior ledger entries, Commando. They stay live. I account for those. This is to settle any question of instrument reliability. I want that uncertainty closed. Leave the prior entries where they are.
    <<ELSE>>
    RATIO: This is the baseline we start from.
    <<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Patch verification nominal. Station relays at 84.8% readiness, recycling the remainder. We hold position here, Commando. This relay node persists until the Seed Pods cycle.
<<END>>
